column1: # IN-D9's vocabulary, first candidate — a MEASUREMENT INPUT, not the shipped label set.
# ⚠⚠ Nothing reads this at runtime. It is the source the harness's label vectors are generated
# from (scripts/inference/embed-label-set.py), and it exists so the quality read has something
# concrete to be wrong about. IN-D9 ends on a per-label review that has NOT happened; treat every
# ⚠ The prompt is spelled out per label rather than templated. A template hides exactly the rows
# where it does not work — "This is a photo of a screenshot" is not a sentence anyone would write,
# and prompt phrasing is a real lever on zero-shot quality. Making it a column makes it reviewable.
# Shape follows IN-D9: two tiers, no deeper. `top` rows are independently thresholded; `leaf` rows
# are argmax-within-siblings plus a margin test, degrading to the parent when the top two are close.
# tier ∈ {top, leaf}; parent is `-` for top rows.
